sources.title: GitHub - clarezahermetica/landling: A tiny LoRA-trained language-model ...
sources.snippet: The Landling is a small experimental language model trained to generate text shaped by Nick Land's public writing, vocabulary, and temperament. He began as a very ridiculous question: how much of a recognizable voice can you teach a 1.1B-parameter model with LoRA, a free GPU, and a manually assembled dataset?

sources.title: clarezahermetica/landling-3.0-cp1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Landling 3.0 — public checkpoint 1 landling-3.0-cp1 is a development checkpoint of Landling, adapted from Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. This repository mainly exists as a versioned record of the model's development. This repository contains a LoRA adapter, tokenizer files, its chat template, training metadata, and provenance.
